The restaurant in part of the O Gallery hotel. We chose it because it was around the corner from our hotel, it looked good and we fancied some western food which they had advertised. The chicken parmigiana I ordered looked good but it was not as tasty as a decent Aussie parma. It came with thin cut chips. The other meal was tenderloin. The service was very good and the surrounds are great but 1.6m vnd for two mains, a dessert and 5 drinks was too expensive for what was delivered.

New York City, New York6020 contributions

Tasty and elaborate presentation
May 2019 • Couples
This authentic Vietnamese dish, Cha ca lang, which is grilled fish with vegetables and peanuts served in a hot plate with rice paper, green lettuce, mint-like green leaves, rectangular sticks of mangoes, carrots and cucumbers, rice noodles and sweet and sour sauce served in a native basket is quite exotic! The basket is artistically presented and colorful (please see attached picture).

Their watermelon drink is pure and fresh. Their spaghetti bolognese was tasty. 

Tha Long Deli Restaurant needs to be lit better. The staff are attentive and food was served within reasonable time. One of their staff wore food gloves and demonstrated how I have to roll my food in the rice wrappers. The sweet and sour dip enhanced the taste of the Cha ca lang.

It is also fun to put all the ingredients on the wrapper and lettuce then roll it. I was not successful in rolling without the rice wrapper tearing though.
